_comment: Simplified Management posts use these dashboard-screenshot images (the established simman visual style). RULES for the producer: (1) NEVER repeat a hook, opening line, core storyline, or dashboard image used in this channel's last ~14 posts - check Buffer's recent posts first. (2) Every post carries THE SPINE: name a specific India-native operator pain precisely (they feel understood) -> show the platform quietly removes it (a guardrail-safe capability) -> land the payoff: they get to focus on what matters and run the business without drowning in admin. (3) Each image below has MANY angles - pick one not used recently, and you may write a fresh angle beyond the list as long as it fits the image and the spine. Rotate images so none repeats within 3 days on a channel. (4) Obey the simman claims guardrail exactly (no channel-manager, two-way sync, real-time, never-double-booked, pricing, occupancy/yield, AI, invented stats/testimonials; a clash is only SURFACED; 8 OTA channels is fine; figures are illustrative). Host the chosen image via upload_media.py OR use its raw GitHub URL, then attach it to the post.
spine: understand the specific pain -> we quietly remove it -> you focus on what matters and run the business with far less effort

dashboards.theme: Co-owner payout statement: earnings and expenses split per booking, a statement per partner (gross, channel fees, housekeeping, GST, net, share).
angles: Co-ownership transparency: nobody can see the split, so every payout ends in a WhatsApp argument. Same numbers, every owner.
The year-end settle-up between partners that always turns tense because the expenses lived in one person's head.
Expense visibility: an owner who only ever sees gross revenue and wonders where the money went - now every deduction is itemised.
A new co-owner joining an existing property and needing to trust the numbers from day one.

dashboards.theme: One calendar across every listing and its channels; a same-night booking clash surfaces on the calendar before check-in.
angles: The clash you find out about at the door - it was visible on the calendar hours earlier.
Six listings each on their own screen; one calendar means you stop tab-hopping to know what's booked.
A long-weekend rush where every property is selling fast and you need one place to see it all.

dashboards.theme: Owner feed: bookings, check-outs, GST invoices and the owner statement in one feed, so an owner knows what's happening without calling anyone.
angles: The remote owner running a Coorg homestay from Bengaluru who only learns the numbers when they ask.
Trust in the manager: the feed means you don't have to choose between micromanaging and being in the dark.
The owner who wanted an asset, not an inbox - now the property reports to them, not the other way round.

dashboards.theme: A GST invoice per booking and a filing-ready statement per property; tax-time and compliance without hunting for numbers.
angles: The pre-20th scramble: hunting invoices across email and WhatsApp before the GST return is due.
The accountant who chases you every month for the same figures you can never find in time.
Month-end reconciliation across several properties collapsed into one clean statement.
The owner who dreads tax season because the paperwork lives everywhere - now it generates itself on check-out.

dashboards.theme: One morning view of the whole day: check-ins, check-outs and the tasks they trigger, across every property.
angles: The morning spent piecing the day together from six WhatsApp groups - now it's one screen you open with your chai.
Running the whole operation in twenty minutes a day instead of being on-call all of it.
The handover between shifts that used to lose a check-in; now the day is written down, not remembered.
Focus on the guest experience because the logistics are already laid out in front of you.

dashboards.theme: Housekeeping and maintenance tasks assigned to a named person, with what's overdue in red; nothing lives in a WhatsApp group.
angles: The task that fell through the cracks and cost you a one-star review about a dirty room.
The AC that broke and nobody owned the fix until an angry guest called.
Housekeeping by WhatsApp forward vs a task with a name, a time, and a red flag when it's late.
Scaling the team without scaling the chaos - every job visible, assigned and accounted for.

dashboards.theme: One listing's bookings across all 8 OTA channels on one screen; same-night clashes surface here (aggregation + clash surfacing only, never sync/channel-manager).
angles: Checking Airbnb, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and five more separately for a single property - now it's one view.
The fragmentation of eight channel logins; see how every channel reads your listing in one place.
The same-night clash between two OTAs that surfaces on this screen before a guest is at the door.
